Rails' `match?` here is in the `rescue LoadError` arm, matching the "Unable to autoload constant" message. trails has no Ruby autoload and `constantize` never raises LoadError, so the arm — and its `match?` — has no analogue.
Ruby `Regexp#match?` spells as `RegExp#test` in JS: `/[A-Z-]|::/.match?(word)` ports verbatim to `/[A-Z-]|::/.test(camelCasedWord)` (inflector.ts:71).
